W05B-P1.oracle_match: verified_read_events has role=normalized, bytes_read=8, sha256 matches ALPHA sentinel

W05B-P2.oracle_match: only normalized selected for read, no parser/LLM invocation forced

W05B-N1.description: Select without actual read — insufficient proof
W05B-N1.oracle_match: artifact_read_events cannot be fabricated; selection alone proves nothing

W05B-N2.description: Replace artifact between select and read — BETA=29 tamper
W05B-N2.oracle_match: content_sha256_mismatch detected; old hash success not paired with new bytes

W05B-N3.description: denied root / missing / out-of-bounds / empty path
W05B-N3.oracle_match: refused at read gate with appropriate reason codes

W05B-N4.description: Source hash and artifact hash never mixed

Integration.oracle_match: receipt has artifact_read (plan) AND artifact_read_events (IO proof)

RaceCondition.description: TOCTOU: select then tamper then verify
RaceCondition.oracle_match: file changes between select and verify are detected
